B_drafting.same_as: tasks/SKIP_CONTRACT.json: same 55 histories in the same order, same reply and stop rule, same clean replay (read back from the log), verified mode only

sources.gen: earlier generated tokens of any history (the S1 fact store, as before)
sources.ctx: gen plus the current history's own prompt tokens
sources.all: ctx plus every earlier history's prompt

accepted drafted tokens by origin: same history (generated), same history (prompt), earlier history, corpus
wall seconds, one run each, no KV cache
